h1: The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel — spacious rooms on a quiet Hat Yai street
intro: If you come to Hat Yai wanting a roomy, high-ceiling room on a budget but would rather not sleep in the thick of the night-market noise, The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel Hatyai is a name budget travelers keep landing on · a small ~36-room boutique on Suwannawong Road, on a street quieter than the market core yet still walkable to Kim Yong Market and Lee Gardens · rooms from approx. ฿650/night, with an overall score of 8.0 from real guest reviews.

body.html: The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel (listed on several platforms as The Bedroom Hatyai) is a small boutique of around 36 rooms on Suwannawong Road in central Hat Yai · what draws people here is rooms that feel noticeably larger and higher-ceilinged than others at the same price, with generously sized bathrooms · it sits on a street quieter than the market core, yet stays within walking distance of Kim Yong Market, Lee Gardens and the Hat Yai City Museum — a fit for travelers who want a calm night without cutting themselves off from the eat-and-shop streets.

Rooms come in several layouts, from a Deluxe Single for solo travelers and a double-bed Superior for two, up to Family Rooms and loft-style units that lift the bed above a small living space · plenty of reviews praise the comfortable beds and clean rooms, and especially bathrooms that feel bigger than expected in this price band · the styling is simple and warm rather than flashy, but it's practical for anyone here mainly to eat and walk the markets.
"Spacious room with a high ceiling, comfortable bed, and the street is nice and quiet at night — a short walk to the market. Great value for the price."

Facilities are about right for a budget boutique — there's a gym, an on-site restaurant, a shared kitchen, free parking and Wi-Fi · drivers especially like that it has its own parking, which is hard to find at this price in central Hat Yai · the location is about a 5-minute walk from the Hat Yai City Museum, with plenty of local restaurants nearby, so finding dinner is easy.

To be straight about it, some reviews mention a musty or damp smell in certain rooms, and soundproofing between rooms that isn't great · a few note that some rooms have windows facing the hallway, which feels a little closed-in, and that the stairs in the loft units are steep with no handrail · these point to a boutique building that's starting to show some age rather than something brand new · if it concerns you, ask to see the room first or pick one with an exterior window when you book.

Opinions on service are split · many reviews say staff are helpful and will arrange transport, while others find the service a bit mechanical or were surprised by an unannounced extra-bed charge at check-in · some rooms also lack a fridge or tea/coffee kit, which is normal at this level but worth knowing if you're used to having those in the room.

Bottom line: The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel is a sensible pick for budget travelers who value a big room, a quiet night and on-site parking over polish or full-service amenities · its overall 8.0 from real Trip.com reviews shows most guests leave satisfied with what they paid · from around ฿650/night for a spacious boutique room with parking in Hat Yai, it's good value for an eat-shop-and-explore trip on a budget.

honestSummary: The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel stands out for spacious high-ceiling rooms, a quiet night and good value — a fit for budget travelers who self-drive or focus on eating and shopping in Hat Yai · it's a boutique building starting to show its age, with some rooms reporting mustiness and limited soundproofing, but for the price and the room you get, it lands well for a budget trip.
honestChecks: If you're sensitive to musty or damp smells — some rooms get reviews about this → ask to see the room before check-in or pick one with an exterior window when booking.
If you want full service and amenities like a big hotel — this is a budget boutique and some rooms lack a fridge or kettle → a 4-star city hotel will suit you better.
If you self-drive and focus on the markets — free parking and a walkable spot to Kim Yong Market are real advantages → book a roomier Superior or Family Room for groups.

faqTitle: FAQ — The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel Hat Yai

faq.q: Where is The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel in Hat Yai, and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 22 Suwannawong Road in central Hat Yai, on a street quieter than the market core · about a 5-minute walk to the Hat Yai City Museum · roughly 11 minutes to Kim Yong Market and Lee Gardens · and about 20 minutes by car from Hat Yai Airport.

faq.q: How much does The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿650/night for a Deluxe Single · there's a double-bed Superior around ฿850, a Corner Junior Suite around ฿1,100 and a Family Room around ฿1,300 · prices vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for budget travelers who want a spacious room and a quiet night, and for self-drivers · high-ceiling rooms, large bathrooms, free parking and a walkable spot to Kim Yong Market · good for couples, solo travelers and small families.

faq.q: Does The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel have parking and a gym?
faq.a: Yes · free on-site parking, a gym, an on-site restaurant and a shared kitchen · the parking is a point drivers praise often, since budget stays in central Hat Yai usually don't have their own.

faq.q: Are there issues with musty smells or noise at The Bedrooms Boutique Hotel?
faq.a: Some reviews mention a musty or damp smell in certain rooms and limited soundproofing between rooms · it's a boutique building showing some age — ask to see the room before check-in or pick one with an exterior window when booking.

faq.q: Are the loft-style rooms suitable for everyone?
faq.a: The loft rooms lift the bed above a small living area and look appealing, but the stairs are fairly steep with no handrail · if you're traveling with older guests or young children, a single-level Superior or Family Room is safer and more convenient.
